Hi Arjun — thanks for sending the docs and the sample invoice. Copying Finance (Monica) and Legal (Lauren) so they can confirm the specifics, but here is the pragmatic checklist to get a PO flowing from our side: 

1) Completed Supplier Onboarding Form (attached) — please fill and sign where indicated.
2) Tax evidence — your GST certificate is good; please confirm the official GST registration number on the form.
3) Bank details and remittance contact for cross-border payments.
4) Sample invoice including the PO placeholder (we require a PO number on the invoice for routing).
5) If you will be charging GST, let us know whether the tax is charged on export of services/goods — include the legal basis or tax counsel note if available.

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_PO_Terms_excerpt.pdf

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding - GST/invoice format guidance

Hi Nisha / Arjun — Monica from Finance here. Quick operational guidance so your AP team can format invoices correctly for fast processing: 

Required on every invoice for payment:
- Redwood PO number (we will provide as soon as vendor record is created)
- Vendor legal name and address (must match onboarding form)
- Vendor GST number (if applicable)
- Invoice line items with unit prices, currency, and subtotal
- Tax line showing GST charged (if any) and total due
- Remittance bank details 

On GST treatment:
- If you zero-rate/export the supply (GST = 0), please include a short statement on the invoice: "GST not charged — export of services, Singapore GST Act reference (if available)" and attach the supporting export documentation with the invoice PDF. That is sufficient for us to process without additional withholding.
- If you do charge GST, we will not withhold tax — Redwood is not registered to reclaim foreign GST automatically. We will pay the invoice as billed. If you need Redwood to provide any self-accounting or reverse-charge paperwork, please include the specific legal reference and we will engage legal.

Operational note: Redwood requires invoices in USD or with a clear exchange rate; for local-currency invoices please indicate the USD equivalent. Standard payment terms are Net 30 unless otherwise agreed.

I'll create the vendor record once I receive the signed onboarding form and a sample invoice PDF with your GST number. Expect PO issuance within 72 business hours after vendor set-up completion.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Payments Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all — legal quick note to keep things simple:

1) Use Redwood's standard PO terms (excerpt attached). Phoenix should not need to sign a separate master for standard freight services unless pricing or indemnities change.
2) For any cross-border VAT/GST policy questions where Phoenix requests Redwood to take on tax obligations (reverse charge, withholding, etc.), we need a written citation of local law or a tax opinion.
3) If Phoenix proposes alternate tax treatment that could create reporting obligations for Redwood, route that through procurement+legal before accepting.

If Phoenix is comfortable with our standard PO terms and will include the GST treatment statement on invoices as Monica requested, legal sign-off is not required.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
